svg.title: Equation Atlas · Cosmic Library
svg.desc: Banner: Equation Atlas. 94 Equations · Live Calculators. Every symbol explained, every example checked. Animation: Equations orbit a glowing nucleus like electrons on three tilted orbits, passing behind it and in front: the rocket equation, vis-viva, E = mc², Newton's gravity, Kepler's third law and the diffraction limit.

g.text: Every symbol explained, every example checked
